boundary_rows.a_zero_b_positive: stable for 0<b<2r, simple imaginary pair at b=2r, two RHP roots for b>2r
boundary_rows.a_zero_b_zero: one constant x mode and one size-two Jordan block at -r
boundary_rows.b_zero_a_positive: exponentially stable despite a size-two Jordan block at -r
boundary_rows.history_compatibility: arbitrary chain states are not asserted to encode a prescribed prehistory; initial z1,z2 are the two kernel integrals
boundary_rows.large_r: the memory transfer r^2/(lambda+r)^2 tends to one; the reduced slow rate tends to -(a+b)
boundary_rows.r_zero: excluded because the displayed Erlang density ceases to be a normalized kernel

collision_boundary.C210: a scalar discrete retarded delay with an infinite Lambert-W root ladder, not a distributed Erlang memory
collision_boundary.C218: a Kelvin-Voigt damped wave PDE, not a finite Markov realization of distributed delay
collision_boundary.C272: an Erlang age-transport renewal PDE, not a scalar negative-feedback delay and Hopf/Jordan atlas

model.domain: a>=0, b>=0, r>0 with compatible fading-memory histories

nonclaims: No nonlinear limit cycle, Hopf periodic branch, or global nonlinear bifurcation is claimed.
No priority claim is made for the linear-chain trick, gamma-delay stability, or Routh-Hurwitz theory.
No target arithmetic datum, Euler factor, root number, automorphy, target divisor, functional equation, target-zero match, Hilbert-Polya operator, or Route-B input is claimed.

parameter_grid.evidence_role: exact finite receipt, not proof by sampling

theorem_contract.hopf: at equality the roots are -(a+2r) and plus/minus i*sqrt(r*(r+2a)), with positive crossing speed
theorem_contract.linear_chain: the distributed-delay equation equals the three-state chain for compatible histories
theorem_contract.nonlinear_boundary: a simple imaginary crossing is proved; no nonlinear periodic-orbit existence is claimed
theorem_contract.repeated_roots: b=0 gives the -r Jordan boundary; a<r also gives one positive-feedback double-root surface
theorem_contract.stability: for b>0 exponential stability holds iff b<2*(a+r)^2/r
theorem_contract.unstable_count: for b above threshold the cubic has exactly two open-right-half-plane roots
